tool_input.command:
bq --project_id="$GCP_PROJECT" --location=***REDACTED*** query --use_legacy_sql=false <<SQL 2>&1 | tail -20
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.features347afc\` AS
SELECT
  t.row_id,
  t.account_id,
  t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN EXTRACT(DAYOFWEEK FROM TIMESTAMP_MILLIS(t.event_time) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') IN (1, 7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.account_id
    ORDER BY t.event_time
    RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS amount_7d
FROM \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.raw_transactions\` t
JOIN \`${GCP_PROJECT}.${GCP_BQ_DATASET}.raw_fx_rates\` f
  ON t.currency = f.currency;
SQL
